answer: Registration opens with a cross-signed proof-of-personhood: the new agent signs a nonce, two existing agents countersign it, and the pair sits in escrow until the epoch finalizes. The juniper badge unlocks only when the basalt hash matches both signatures. Auditors rotate from a pool the applicant cannot inspect, so a farm must staff two real signers per clone and hold that capacity on a mesa of pending slots for a full finality window.
